description: Command registration and execution, key combo and keybinding models, core default bindings, reserved-key policy, the keybinding store, global keydown dispatch to commands, Escape override registry, keybinding presets with import and export, the keybinding settings panel and edit dialogs, and the bottom-panel shortcuts reference. Settings persistence, dialogs, and the bottom panel itself remain external.

characterizationScenarios.name: Key combos parse keyboard events and respect reserved keys
Keybinding store merges defaults with user bindings and unsets
Keydown dispatch runs commands, honors dialogs and canvas focus, and lets Escape overrides win
Presets switch, save, import, and export through the keybinding panel
Shortcuts tab lists essential and view-control keybindings
Commands register, execute with error handling, and expose keybinding labels

compatibilityPromises: Unclassified callers may import keybinding internals during inventory; imports from classified domains remain subject to cross-domain rules.
Extension-registered keybindings and the Comfy.Keybinding.* settings keep their stored shape.

presetService opening presentation dialogs and reaching scripts/api directly, and keybindingService reading settings and dialog stores, remain visible as role-boundary debt; classification does not grant dependency exceptions.
